name: llansannan-community
description: Llansannan Community website: events, news and a moderator area, on Cloudflare.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply llansannan --local --env dev && wrangler d1 execute llansannan --local --env dev --file=seed/dev-seed.sql
scripts.test: node tests/moderation-rules.test.mjs && node tests/regular-activities.test.mjs && node tests/news-photos.test.mjs && node tests/sign-in-github.test.mjs
